reviewNotes: Held back: the page gives no year for the tune; the score has a bar of another length (bar 16), which the solfa grid does not draw. Imported from CCEH tune 000689 (the melody read from 000689a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Philip P. Bliss's dates (1838–1876) are from our page for the tune BLANDY (content/hymns/tunes/blandy.json); CCEH's page gives none. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000689a.nwc).
